description:
List lots in Okun Koneosa's online auction (huutokauppa).

The auction sells new and used machines, tools and supplies. Use this when
the customer asks about the auction, used machines or bidding. Auction lots
are NOT in search_catalog: they are single items sold to the highest bidder.

Args:
    query: Optional Finnish keyword matched against title, description,
        manufacturer, model and condition. Leave empty to list all lots.
    limit: Maximum lots to return (1-20, default 10).

Returns:
    JSON with status ('open', 'coming' or 'closed'), opens_label when the
    auction opens later, section_url, terms_url and lots. Each lot has
    title, condition, current_price, min_next_bid, bid_count, ends_at,
    pickup_town, delivery, vat and lot_url.

Notes:
    - Bidding is not possible through this tool. Share lot_url; the customer
      bids on the lot page with their own account.
    - A bid in the last 3 minutes extends ends_at by 3 minutes, so prices
      and end times change. Fetch again rather than reusing old values.
    - Some used lots are sold under the margin scheme: VAT is included but
      not itemised, and a business buyer cannot deduct it (see `vat`).
    - For auction rules (payment, pickup, withdrawal right) use
      search_shop_policies_and_faqs with query "huutokauppa".
name: search_auctions
